title: 30-Storey Condo Tower Proposed Near Allandale Waterfront GO in Barrie
summary: A 30-storey condominium tower is proposed at 51–59 Tiffin Street in Barrie’s Allandale neighbourhood, within the Allandale GO Major Transit Station Area. Designed by Architecture Unfolded for 1000658096 Ontario Inc, the tower would rise on the south side of Tiffin Street, west of Essa Road. Machinery was reportedly clearing the area as of October, 2026 ahead of construction.
